column1: # RBB SRv6 qualification — circuit_info TEMPLATE (replace with your values).
# This file is the SINGLE source of physical wiring for the RBB SRv6 slice.
#   * CORE port-channels + members — rows whose two endpoints are BOTH DUTs and
#     whose local endpoint carries a parent port-channel (columns 4 & 8). Members
#     are grouped per node under that parent (e.g. port-channel1 = eth1/1
#   * IXIA edges + IXIA-port map     — rows with role=IXIA (last column). The
#     DUT-side local_interface maps to the IXIA-side neighbor_interface
#     expressed as "slot/port" (e.g. 1/3) so it drops straight into IxNetwork.
# Point the harness / loader at your copy with:  export TAAC_CIRCUIT_INFO_PATH=path/to/your_circuit_info.csv
# Bind the RBB roles with TAAC_RBB_R1_HOST / TAAC_RBB_R2_HOST (must match hostnames below).
# status=3 => active. Lines starting with '#' are comments. All names below are
# generic placeholders — replace with your real interfaces / IXIA card-port pairs.
# --- Core underlay: two port-channels between R1 and R2 (one row per direction) ---
# --- IXIA edges: DUT edge interface <-> IXIA physical port (slot/port) ---
